theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid N → Euclid P) (V : Set (Euclid N)) (F : Euclid N → ℝ), IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ Gh : Euclid N → Euclid P, Measurable Gh ∧ ContinuousOn Gh V ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, Gh y ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid N →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ (∀ e, inner ℝ (Gh y) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) ∧ (∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid N →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ e, inner ℝ v (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → v = Gh y) ∧ (Gh y = 0 ↔ fderiv ℝ F y = 0)
